episodes.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
probes: Four boys finish a long Dungeons & Dragons game in a suburban basement, then pedal off home through the dark.
A nervous girl in a hospital gown wanders into a small roadside diner, and the owner sits her down with food.
Inside a government laboratory, staff examine a strange organic substance oozing from a wall down in the basement.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
fine: The boys argue in Mike's basement about what to do with the girl they brought home.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
probes: Hopper sits with lab staff and watches security footage from the front gate on the night Will vanished.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Body
probes: The boys sneak Eleven into their school after hours, hoping the ham radio there is powerful enough.
Joyce tears the wallpaper off her living room wall, following her son's voice coming through it.
Steve argues with Nancy, worried mainly about getting in trouble with his father rather than her missing friend.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
probes: The boys trek through the woods in a line, each of them watching the needle of a compass.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Monster
probes: Eleven wanders into a grocery store and walks out with an armful of stolen Eggo waffle boxes.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
probes: After fleeing on their bikes, the kids hole up in a junkyard to wait things out.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
probes: Inside the Byers house, Nancy and Jonathan each draw a blade across their palm.

episodes.title: Chapter One: MADMAX
probes: Nancy and Steve sit through an awkward dinner with Barb's parents, who still speak about their daughter as missing.
Joyce has started dating a man she knew back in high school, her first relationship since Will's return.
Dustin and Lucas are distracted all week by a new girl who has just transferred into their school.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
probes: The boys are out trick-or-treating in costume when Max turns up and tags along with them.
Nancy drinks far too much at a crowded high school Halloween party full of costumed teenagers.
Hopper crouches over another rotting pumpkin field, pulling up a handful of strange organic matter.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Pollywog
probes: Bob cheerfully encourages Will to face his fears head-on, with no idea what Will's episodes actually are.
fine: Hopper confronts Owens, accusing him of letting the gate get away from him, and frets about the rotting pumpkin fields.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Will the Wise
probes: Lucas tries to get closer to Max, but her older stepbrother steps in and shuts it down.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Dig Dug
probes: Bob sits at the Byers' house poring over the pages of Will's crayon scribbles taped together across the floor.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Spy
probes: Returning to the Byers' house, Nancy and Jonathan find Will's scribbled drawings spread across the floor.
fine: Steve leads the kids out to a junkyard, setting up a trap to lure Dart there.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
probes: Inside the darkened lab, the group shut themselves in a room after the power cuts out.
Owens stays behind at a monitor, talking someone through the lab's darkened corridors over the radio.

episodes.title: Chapter Nine: The Gate
probes: Against the agreed plan, Steve climbs down into the tunnels with Mike, Dustin, Max and Lucas.
